description: “Truth, Justice and the American Way”… West Virginia style. You don’t have to look very hard to see what happens when we become politically complacent, just turn on the news. With the Russian invasion of Ukraine, we are experiencing the consequences of failed leadership. Local decisions affect world events, and world events have local impact. Do you like what you see happening elsewhere, do you want to protect our way of life, and maybe make it better? I do and I am. - Rick4WV88
